When you view one of our live camera pages you will normally be connected to the live camera after a few seconds. During this time you will see a connecting message, test card or an animated display indicating that the connection process has started.

The type of connecting message you receive will depend on the type of camera feed that you are connecting to as real time and time lapse camera feeds are quite different.

Once connected the picture will start to show and you can enjoy the live webcam. If you are using a mobile device to view a real time streaming camera then you will need to tap the play button in the display window to start the live feed.

Be patient as some cameras will take longer to connect than others. If a particular live webcam is not available then come back to it later and have another try. The live streaming cameras have a full screen option and some of them have live audio too.

Each selection from the map takes you to a camera in that region and from there you can select other camera's in the same area or return here to choose another UK webcam.

In addition to the UK cameras we also have webcams from all over the world and even seasonal Christmas webcams including a live 24 hour Christmas channel playing films music and carols all through the Christmas period.

At Camsecure we provide the equipment, technology, expertise and backup you need to get your cameras streaming on the Internet for what ever application you choose. We can provide the equipment and streaming technology so you can put a live streaming webcam on your own site with your own branding and logo, and If you would like to stream your cameras to your website and need an installation service then we can help you with that too.

We hope you enjoy viewing our live cameras, contact us with any enquiries and please come back soon.
